problem_description: 5 cases waited an average of 15 days to reach Booking Confirmed.
action_taken: Set an entry SLA for Booking Confirmed: Agree a target number of days.; Flag overdue cases.

problem_description: 3 cases passed through Document Collection more than once — the same step is being redone instead of carried forward.
action_taken: Make the first Document Collection the only one: Use a fixed checklist for Document Collection so the first pass captures everything.; Record the outcome of Document Collection on the case row itself, visible to everyone.; Only repeat Document Collection when its recorded outcome is genuinely missing.

problem_description: 3 cases returned to Placement Offer after having moved past it — earlier work is being redone under time pressure.
action_taken: Confirm before leaving Placement Offer, hold a reserve: Re-confirm the inputs to Placement Offer at the point of completion, not just at the start.; Keep a small reserve (people, slots or stock) to absorb fall-throughs.; Record the reason for every loop-back so repeat causes are spotted early.
